prompts.featured: Use case: stylized-concept. Original MEE editorial illustration with tactile ceramic, cut paper, translucent glass and porous limestone. Ivory #F7F6F2, cobalt #1547BB, vermilion #EF383E, restrained charcoal. Gallery studio lighting, bold clear composition, material grain and realistic cast shadows. No text, readable characters, numerals, logos, flags, watermarks or identifiable people. A conceptual scene, not documentary evidence, an actual chart or data map, or accusation against a real institution. Wide cover1200:630. An oversized folded ivory newspaper with entirely blank geometric page blocks floats above a cobalt desk. A single anonymous ceramic hand in a plain blue sleeve emerges partially from outside the top frame to hold its upper corner; a vermilion ribbon links its lower edge to a small blank public announcement panel. Editorial metaphor about the influence of funding, no official seal or real newspaper.
